input_units: raw int16 counts as read from MPU6050

formulas.kurt: excess kurtosis: mean((x-mu)^4)/var^2 - 3 with population moments; 0 if var==0
formulas.domfreq: (argmax over k=1..64 of |rfft(x-mean(x))[k]|) * FS / N (bin 0 excluded; first max wins ties)
formulas.std_rel: std of the window divided by that node's commissioning level (median std over >= 20 healthy commissioning windows of the same axis)
